prompt: Was the person who served as president of the Scottish National Party from 1987 to 2005 alive when the party was founded?
answer: Yes. The person was **Winnie Ewing**, born in **1929**. The SNP was founded on **7 April 1934**, so she was alive—about four years old—when the party was founded.
